ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all managers, shareholders and UBOs against PEP databases (French HATVP published political officials, EU PEP lists, internationally recognized PEP registers), UN Security Council consolidated sanctions, EU CFSP restrictive measures, OFAC SDN, French Treasury financial sanctions (gel des avoirs list), and the French AML/CFT sectoral reporting obligations to Tracfin; ongoing monitoring required under Article L.561-6; enhanced due diligence applies to PEPs, cross-border wire transfers, and high-risk non-EU jurisdictions.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet Unique des Formalités d'Entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr), operated by INPI; RCS registration records are public through the Registre National des Entreprises (RNE) and Infogreffe.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The legal name (dénomination sociale) must be written in the Latin alphabet for insertion in the RCS; Chinese characters may be used only as an auxiliary trade name (enseigne). A pinyin/Latin transliteration of the Chinese malatang brand must be chosen as the legal name, which must be distinctive, not misleading, and not identical or confusingly similar to existing nationally registered marks in the foodservice/trademark classes. The SARL suffix must be expressed as 'SARL' or 'Société à responsabilité limitée'.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: France (where it implies state affiliation or public service)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name rejection is communicated by the Guichet Unique/INPI with written reasons. The applicant may submit a corrected restatement immediately and file a 'recours gracieux' to INPI's business-formalities directorate within 30 days. If rejected again, the applicant may bring a judicial petition before the competent tribunal judiciaire or, for registry issues, the tribunal de commerce supervising the greffe, within two months from the final refusal. Extension of an intended name is not automatic unless the full incorporation dossier has been filed and the registry has issued a reservation pending completion.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A French SARL may lawfully domicile its registered office with an approved domiciliation service or, for a maximum of two years, at the manager's residence, provided the domiciliation agreement is validly entered into and filed with the registry. This is sufficient only for the administrative seat. The malatang self-serve restaurant must maintain a physical establishment in France, subject to health registration under Regulation (EC) No. 852/2004, local DDPP/ARS health checks, fire safety approval, and labor law inspection; a virtual office cannot satisfy operating substance for a food business.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High (approximately 75–85%) for the foodservice operating site due to statutory DDPP food-safety, health, SDIS fire-safety and Inspection du travail labor inspections; moderate (approximately 20–30%) for the administrative registered office if served by a compliant domiciliation company.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Book II, Articles L.210-1 to L.210-10 (general company provisions) and L.223-1 to L.223-43 (Société à Responsabilité Limitée); registration provisions in L.123-91 to L.123-93 and regulatory Decree No. 67-236 concerning the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) at the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce of the applicable commercial court, now filed electronically through the Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI) Guichet Unique des Formalités d'Entreprises.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Initial statutes (Statuts constitutifs) signed or electronically executed by all associates, accompanied by the Cerfa Form M0 application for RCS registration and the Declaration of Beneficial Ownership.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: There is no statutory minimum capital for a SARL; the capital is freely fixed in the statutes. Cash contributions must be paid up to at least 20% of the subscribed amount before the incorporation application, the balance payable within five years, and in-kind contributions must be fully delivered at formation. The cash contribution is held in a blocked escrow bank account with a licensed deposit institution or the notary and may be released only upon issuance of the Kbis extract.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST MANAGERS' MEETING OF [COMPANY] - RESOLUTION NO. 1. The managers, having considered the draft statuts, the attested capital deposit, and the subscriptions, unanimously resolve: (1) the share subscription is ratified and all shares are issued to the subscribers named in the statuts for their agreed contribution; (2) the registered office is fixed at [address], the commercial premises where the broth-bowl production and self-service operations will be conducted, with the statutory books kept there; (3) the managers designated in the statuts are appointed, are hereby empowered to bind the company, open bank accounts, and oversee licensing procedures; (4) each appointee accepts the office. This resolution is effective upon signing and will be filed in the company register.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Verification of Corporate Name and Drafting of the Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Online Name Database and the Guichet Unique Entreprises portal (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr); registry name index compiled from the RCS and Infogreffe database.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Check the availability of the proposed corporate name against the national business names and trademarks register to avoid confusion with an existing legal entity. Draft the full statutes containing the corporate form, share capital, share subscription table, registered office address, corporate purpose, management provisions, duration, and any share transfer restrictions. Verify that the proposed object covers self-service restaurants, broth-bowl preparation, fast-casual food service, and franchising. Have each initial associate sign the statutes electronically or before a notary where an authentic deed is required.
required_dossiers: Draft statutes of the SARL
Identity documents of each subscribing associate
List of initial associates and their respective shares
Proposed registered office address and supporting occupancy document
Written acceptance of office from each proposed manager
Declaration of no criminal disqualification for each manager
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the chosen name is unavailable or likely to cause confusion, formally amend the statutes through a private rectification deed, select a distinguishing secondary name, and refile before incurring announcement expenses.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Subscription Payment and Blocked Capital Deposit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed French bank, deferral bank, Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations, or the sequestered account of the notary conducting the incorporation.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary non-business account in the name of the company in formation or on behalf of the subscribers. Collect the cash portion of the subscribed capital, paying at least 20% of each cash contribution. Obtain an attestation of deposit (certificat de dépôt de fonds) describing the subscribers, the amount received, and the blocked status. The deposited amount may not be withdrawn or transferred until the registry issues a certificate of registration and the Kbis extract.
required_dossiers: Provisional signature specimen for the account
Draft statutes of the company in formation
Subscriber identity documents and subscription forms
List of associates and share allocation table
Documentary origin of substantial cash funds where applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank or notary returns a query concerning the subscribers or the constitution of funds, revise the subscription table and statutory share allocations, obtain fresh signatures, and secure a corrected certificate of deposit before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the Statutory Legal Announcement in an Authorized Journal
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Journal of Legal Announcements (Journal d'Annonces Légales) authorized for the department of the registered office; legal notice repository managed by the Civil Law Office of the Ministry of Justice.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Place an announcement in a valid legal gazette following the model prescribed for SARL incorporation. The notice must contain the corporate name, abbreviation, corporate form, capital amount, registered office, corporate purpose, duration, managers' surnames and forenames, and the intended RCS court. Obtain the publication receipt and the publisher's certificate, which are required for the registry filing. The announcement should be published before the date of the form M0 submission to the Guichet Unique.
required_dossiers: Completed legal announcement text
Signed statutes of the company
Certificate of capital deposit or notarial attestation
Corporate name availability confirmation
Identity particulars of the managers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the legal announcement is defective, incomplete, or published after the filing date, instruct the legal publication journal to publish a corrective withdrawal or supplemental insertion and retain the corrected certificate for submission as an explanatory attachment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic Filing of the Registration Dossier with the Guichet Unique / RCS
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI) Guichet Unique des Formalités d'Entreprises; transmitted to the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce of the registered office for inclusion in the RCS.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the Cerfa M0 declaration in the Guichet Unique portal and attach all required documents, including the signed statutes, capital deposit certificate, legal announcement receipt, registered office lease or title, manager acceptances, beneficial owner declaration, and proof of payment of the registry charge. Validate the dossier, pay the electronically computed filing fee, and monitor the processing status. The registry will issue an attestation de dépôt and, once accepted, an extract of the company's registration containing its SIREN and RCS number.
required_dossiers: Completed and signed Form M0
Signed original statutes of the SARL
Capital deposit certificate from the bank or notary
Legal announcement publication certificate
Proof of registered office occupancy (lease, utility bill, or title)
Manager acceptance letters and identity documents
Beneficial owner declaration
Payment receipt of the filing fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Upon receipt of an order to regularize (ordre de régularisation), identify the missing document or defective statement, correct the affected annex, and resubmit through the Guichet Unique within the stated cure period. If the registry maintains a refusal, apply for judicial review before the President of the Commercial Court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Identification, INSEE and Social Security Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce; Institut National de la Statistique et des Études Économiques (INSEE); Urssaf; regional occupational health service.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the RCS registration is entered, verify the automatic issuance of the SIREN, SIRET, and APE activity code. Confirm the manager's affiliation with the French social security system under the applicable non-employee or assimilated-salaried worker scheme. If employees are hired, register the company with Urssaf, set up the DSN payroll declarations, and contract with the locally approved occupational health service. Record the company's official corporate identity in the bank and insurance contracts.
required_dossiers: Kbis extract issued by the registry
RCS registration certificate
SIREN, SIRET and INSEE assignment notice
Manager's identity and social security number
Evidence of registered office address
Contracts with bank, insurer, and administrative service providers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the SIREN or APE code is missing or erroneously allocated, file a rectification request with INSEE through the Guichet Unique portal and attach the Kbis extract as proof of legal registration; correct any inconsistent managerial affiliation directly with Urssaf.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Direction Départementale de l'Emploi, du Travail, des Solidarités et de la Protection des Populations (DDETSPP) for food hygiene and workplace safety; Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (DREAL) for environmental matters; departmental fire safety commissions and the municipal authorities for public-access establishments.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Déclaration d'ouverture d'un établissement de restauration commerciale / Attestation de formation en hygiène alimentaire (HACCP); separate licence to sell alcoholic beverages (licence de débit de boissons) if alcohol service is proposed under the Public Health Code.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (DREAL) and the competent municipal sewer authority responsible for discharge permits.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from a full environmental impact assessment for a typical self-serve broth-bowl kitchen, provided the food preparation capacity remains below the ICPE registration threshold of Rubric 2930 (10 tonnes per day of finished product). Above that threshold, the establishment must file an environmental registration dossier with DREAL before commencement of operation.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge to the municipal network must meet the local sewer authority's authorisation limits for pH, biochemical oxygen demand, chemical oxygen demand, and suspended solids; grease traps must retain fats and oils to prevent discharges above conventional standards; used cooking oils must be stored in sealed containers and removed by registered waste collectors; kitchen extract vents must be fitted with grease filters meeting the applicable arrêté municipal requirements for volatile organic compounds, odours, and noise nuisance.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate issued by the departmental commission of safety for public-access establishments classified Type N (restaurants), comprising at least one visit or dossier review after opening; electrical installation compliance certificate (Consuel) for all cooking appliances, extraction systems, and lighting; structural load inspection confirming that the floor slab can withstand self-serve broth stations, refrigerated counters, ventilation ducting, and seating layout; workplace clearance evidenced by the Document Unique d'Évaluation des Risques, crew medical fitness checks, and HACCP hygiene training certificates kept on the premises.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFIP) – portal: impots.gouv.fr; business registration portal: formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr / guichet unique
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity establishing a French SARL completes company formation via the Guichet Unique (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) with the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés, obtaining SIREN and SIRET numbers. The DGFIP then automatically issues the French Intra-Community VAT number (numéro de TVA intracommunautaire) after the SARL is allocated to the national VAT regime. For a foreign entity not established in France but making taxable supplies in France, the DGFIP requires a direct application for a French VAT number using cerfa forms or the non-established taxable person procedure; a tax representative must be appointed if the entity is established outside the EU.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: France has no general check-the-box election. A SARL is subject to corporate income tax (impôt sur les sociétés) by default. A family SARL or a small SARL whose partners are all natural persons may irrevocably opt, limited to five fiscal years, for transparent taxation under income tax (Article 239 bis AA CGI). Hybrid mismatch rules are implemented under Articles 234 et seq. CGI pursuant to ATAD, with no elective check-the-box intermediary treatment; VAT grouping (assujettis uniques) is available on application under Article 256 C CGI.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (TVA – Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 91,900 (2025 franchise base de TVA threshold for sales of goods) and EUR 36,800 (for services) for French-established small undertakings; for non-established foreign suppliers, no threshold is available – any first supply of taxable goods or services in France, or sale through a fully taxable agent/warehouse, triggers compulsory VAT registration and reporting obligations.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: French B2B e-invoicing mandate applies under Ordonnance n° 2021-1190 and new CGI Article 289. From 1 September 2026 all French-established taxable persons must receive and send structured electronic invoices (Factur-X or EDI format) through a certified Partner Dematerialization Platform (PDP) or the Public Invoicing Portal (PPF), with e-reporting of B2C sales and cross-border transactions via the same infrastructure. Real-time clearance is achieved through the mandatory transmission of invoice data to the DGFIP for fiscal verification before any input VAT deduction is recognized.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to physical exports of goods outside the European Union under Article 262-1-I CGI where the seller ships the goods out of EU territory, or exports for the buyer who is established outside the EU. Export-related services (e.g., freight, storage, processing) may also be zero-rated under Article 262-1-II CGI when directly linked to the export. The taxpayer must hold documentary proof of the physical departure from the EU and issue an invoice expressly stating 'exonération export' with reference to the applicable provision; which must be produced at the time of the transaction and retained for the statutory six-year archiving period.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DAU / IE-501 or SAD) with validated exit from the EU customs territory
Bill of Lading (ocean/air/road) or other satisfactory transport evidence (CMR, AWB)
Inward Remittance Certificate (bordereau de change / attestation de rapatriement des fonds) evidencing payment receipt from the foreign buyer
Commercial invoice with Incoterm 2020 export terms (EXW, FCA, FOB, etc.)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGFIP customs auditors verify the physical reality of exports through documentary evidence and cross-border data reconciliation. Unjustified zero-rating leads to the reversal of output VAT with delinquent interest, plus penalties under Article 1729 CGI: 40% penalty for deliberate misstatement, 80% penalty for hidden compulsory disclosures or active document falsification, and 80% recourse against abuse of law. In addition, Article 1741 CGI criminal sanctions apply for tax fraud, carrying up to 5 years' imprisonment and a substantial statutory fine; retrospective clawback is possible for up to three years (six years for undisclosed business activity under the right-to-audit period).

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (BdF) under the monetary policy framework of the European Central Bank (ECB); exchange control statistics and balance-of-payments reporting are administered by BdF as agent of the Direction Générale du Trésor (DGT) of the French Ministry of Economy, Finance and Industrial and Digital Sovereignty. Legal basis: Code monétaire et financier (CMF), Articles L151-1 et seq. and R152-1 et seq.; EU capital movement liberalisation under TFEU Article 63.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France maintains full de jure and de facto convertibility of the euro (EUR) for both current and capital account transactions according to OECD Code of Liberalisation and IMF Article VIII status. No exchange control approval is required for inbound equity injection, shareholder loans, royalty receipts, or profit repatriation to an EU/EEA resident parent company. For non-EU (e.g., Chinese) shareholders, no separate French FX authorisation applies, but the beneficiaire must file a DGT foreign direct investment (FDI) declaration only for sensitive activities under the EU FDI Screening Regulation; fast-casual restaurant franchising is NOT a sensitive sector, so no prior FDI authorisation is required. Profit remittance hurdles: an EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive exemption (0% French WHT) applies to dividends paid to an EU/EEA corporate parent holding ≥5% for 24 months; for a Chinese corporate parent, domestic French withholding is 25% (Art. 119 bis CGI), reduced to 10% under the France-China DTT if the parent holds ≥25% of share capital on the dividend payment date; standard French CIT (25%) is levied on profits from royalty and franchising income.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Statutory timeline: N/A. France abolished all export-proceeds surrender and mandatory conversion obligations; exporters may retain 100% of proceeds in EUR or freely hold foreign currency for an unlimited period. However, cross-border monetary links must be declared to Banque de France on a monthly/quarterly basis (reporting of external transactions 'REX' / 'liaisons financières avec l'étranger') where cumulative flows exceed EUR 750,000 per calendar year or EUR 15 million for related-party trade finance. The reporting obligation applies to the resident FR_SARL and is filed through the Banque de France OneGate portal using the CMF purpose codes; the restaurant franchisor's royalty receipts from non-resident franchisees constitute 'services' flows (code 678) and must be reported as exports of services, but no conversion ratio applies.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (Compte de dépôt des fonds de constitution) then converted to Operational Corporate Account
Operational Account / Franchise Royalty Collection Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank / LCL SA
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account with dedicated sub-accounts for franchisee clearing
Operational Account with treasury pooling (sweeping for franchisee settlement)
Operational Account (cash management and border-crossing payment services)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: HIGH for operational satellite accounts and low-value franchise royalty collection; LOW for capital escrow and primary treasury account. Legal constraints: an Electronic Money Institution (EMI) licensed in France (e.g., Qonto, Lydia Solutions) or passporting into France under a European EMI (e.g., Wise, Revolut, Bunq) may operate as money transmitters but cannot void the requirement of a credit institution account for SARL capital constitution; under CMF Art. L521-3, only ACPR-licensed credit institutions can receive paid-in share capital and issue a 'certificat du dépositaire des fonds' executed by a notaire/registrar. EMIs may be used for POS settlement of the Malatang outlets and cross-border supplier disbursements, subject to IBAN segregation and no customer-fund lending.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mandatory biometric identification of the gérant (manager) and any UBO holding ≥25% of FR_SARL. For a Chinese national residing in China, physical attendance at the French bank branch (or a notarised Procuration to a French resident representative) is required at onboarding; remote opening is possible only via the PVID digital identity scheme, but Tier-1 French banks almost uniformly require one physical interview with the ultimate decision-maker, an original passport, and apostilled corporate documents. Onboarding timeline typically 3-6 weeks from submission of the Kbis extract.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO resident in the People's Republic of China subject to enhanced sanctions screening and Beneficial Ownership Register (RBE) verification; source-of-wealth determination for the EUR share capital contribution.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified and apostilled PRC passport plus notarised proof of residential address; official PRC Business License (营业执照) of the Chinese holding entity; international bank reference letter from the remitting Chinese bank; audited financial statements or tax returns evidencing source of funds; signed sworn declaration of UBO nature and source of wealth; documentary record of upstream group structure linking the Chinese shareholder to non-sanctioned, operating businesses in the F&B sector.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cash-intensive franchise business model with high POS turnover and uneven royalty remittances, posing a laundering risk via commingling of store cash receipts.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed master franchise agreements and the Franchise Disclosure Document (DIP); monthly POS/MID transaction logs with merchant acquiring terminals; projected royalty and advertising fund waterfall schedule; register of franchisee IDs; quarterly VAT returns (CA3) and a cash-management policy showing daily uncontaminated cash lodgement to the operating account; audited annual accounts of the French holding SARL.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border related-party funding: shareholder loans or trade advances from the Chinese parent triggering scrutiny on thin capitalisation and unregulated credit activity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Written shareholders' loan agreement (contrat de prêt entre associés) with arm's-length interest rate (monthly tax-deductible threshold per Art. 212 CGI); French Treasury DGT declaration of non-sensitive FDI status; SAFE Foreign Debt Registration Certificate and SAFE settlement/sale of foreign exchange verification form where the loan is funded in CNY; evidence that the loan is recorded in the SARL's balance sheet as 'associé - compte courant'; clause restricting drawing until the deposit certificate is issued by the receiving bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Premature or irregular legal status of the SARL at account opening (pre-incorporation delays, unreported change of gérant, or insufficient registered address proof).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised Certificate of Deposit of Share Capital (certificat du dépositaire des fonds); final version of the Articles of Association (statuts); candidacy acceptance of gérant; registered full lease (bail commercial) or domiciliation agreement for the registered office; Kbis extract issued within the last 3 months; joint minutes of the incorporation decision executing the capital increase and opening of bank accounts.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocol: Chinese shareholder instructs SWIFT MT103 (or CIPS/CNY cross-border payment) to the FR_SARL Euro account at BNP Paribas/SocGen with beneficiary bank BIC, IBAN, and full legal name; critical fields require the correct purpose code — for equity injection use 'Capital increase, non-resident direct investment' (Banque de France CMF-BOP 3: 'B9-CRE' or 'K3' code family); the French receiving bank collects the 'motif du règlement' and the 'État de la contrepartie'. Verification steps: (i) Banque de France requires the entity to register the inward FDI in the statistical survey when cumulative external debt/equity exceeds €750,000; (ii) the Chinese remitting bank must obtain SAFE's FDI foreign exchange registration and the Overseas Direct Investment (ODI) certificate for the Chinese parent; (iii) a Creditor/Debtor reference must show 'Capital apport' to allow the French notaire to issue the capital deposit certificate; use IBAN in 'Account With Institution' and include mode code 'U' for settlement of capital. For CNY-RMB inbound wires, the receiving French bank converts on receipt at market rate, but a pre-arranged EUR/CNH forward is recommended to lock conversion.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails for the franchise supply chain: (i) SWIFT MT103 for EUR/CNY settlement of inventory imports and equipment purchases from Chinese suppliers; (ii) Documentary collections (CAD/DP) and Commercial Letters of Credit (LC at sight or usance) opened by the French bank in favour of Chinese beneficiary banks under UCP600, particularly for the first tranche of Malatang woks, POS terminals, and self-serve condiment stations; (iii) SEPA Credit Transfer (SCT Inst) for royalty rebates to French-franchisee operational accounts; (iv) CIPS/CNY direct clearing where the Chinese supplier provides a CNH account, with the French bank executing via Paris offshore CNY market. All outbound trade payments above €12,500 are routed via SEPA or SWIFT with the CSH code and must be accompanied by evidence of invoice, customs declarations (import VAT deductible under TVA), and compliant with the Banque de France external payments statistical reporting thresholds.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable EUR/USD and EUR/CNH FX Forward (Change à terme ferme) — permitted under French MiFID II execution via ACPR-regulated credit institution with an ISDA/FBF 2013 Master Agreement; no direct FR-FX-approval required.

Offshore Chinese Renminbi Non-Deliverable Forward (NDF) on USD/CNH or EUR/CNH — permissible to hedge CNY-denominated franchisee settlement where onshore CNY convertibility is restricted; settlement in EUR or USD in London/Paris CNH market.
Vanilla cross-currency interest rate swap (XCCY) — matching the EUR shareholders' loan or commercial facility against CNH/USD liability streams, documented under the 2018 FBF Master Agreement.

Plain-vanilla European FX options (purchased only, no sold option writing) — to overlay downside protection on budgeted royalty and inventory flows without leveraged component; binary and knock-in exotic structures prohibited for SME treasury.

FX Swaps (Swap de change) — for liquidity clearing between the Euribor-based treasury account and the Chinese settlement leg where franchisees remit partial payments in CNY via CIPS windows; typical 1-week to 1-month tenor, collateralised under the French code monétaire et financier Annex.
